# Emberoo

> Emberoo is a free, colorful 2D side-scrolling platform adventure game playable directly in any web browser on PC, mobile, iPhone, iPad, and tablet.

## Overview
- Website: https://emberoo.vercel.app/
- Genre: 2D Platformer / Side-Scrolling Adventure / Arcade
- Platform: Web (HTML5 Canvas, React, TypeScript, Vite)
- Cost: 100% Free to play

## Story & Gameplay
Players leap through three fiery, beautifully illustrated realms:
1. Sunny Grasslands (Level 1)
2. Copper Dune Run (Level 2)
3. Emberpeak Pass (Level 3)

The goal is to leap across gaps, dodge hazards (fireballs, pillars, moving platforms), collect stars/companions, and reach the final portal.

## Custom Character Studio & Sharing
- Custom Hero: Players can upload or paste their own character images.
- Custom Collectible: Players can customize the companion character.
- Custom Sound Effects: Players can upload custom audio or use the default 'Fahhh' sound.
- Adventure Share Links: Players can generate instant share links containing compressed custom character configs so friends can play the exact customized adventure.

## Controls
- Movement: Arrow Left/Right or A/D keys
- Jump: Spacebar, W, or Arrow Up
- Pause: ESC key or in-game Pause button
- Mobile / Touch: Ergonomic on-screen tactile D-Pad and Jump button with multi-touch support
